_about: Empire (style id premium-iman; the Iman Gadzhi shorts look), Phantasic Premium, BETA. A dark, high-contrast talking head (empire-noir grade: crushed blacks, teal shadows) with ONE phrase at a time in glowing heavy ALL-CAPS typed on behind a cursor bar; calm lines white, verdict lines red, bigger, slammed in with a shake and a low hit. Key nouns become glowing cut-out objects on a near-black stage. Punch-ins alternate 1.0 / 1.12 with eased motion blur. The talk ends on a riser, 3 frames of silence and a boom, then the music bed's own drop takes over: a beat-locked cut ladder (2, 1, then half beats) of cinematic stills and the speaker's own shots with white flash cuts. Ends on a black caps CTA card with a green arrow and a fade to black. v0.6 hook (photo plate + relight via reel stage.plate/fg); v0.4 hook (10 Oct): the speaker is cut out (matte) and composited on a designed dark neon set (red bar, blue lamp, haze) with red/blue light wraps; captions sit BETWEEN the set and the speaker so the head covers part of the type (DtFS). Engine: premium kit + captions.style 'type', endcard variant 'caps', drop.bpm/beats, music.alignDrop/dropLift (references/reel-json.md, Premium line). Port notes: stage.room 300 and music.optional are set HERE (the engine defaults stay 150 / required) so Podcast Glow and every other style are unchanged; head-bang is not shipped, so the bed is skipped with a warning..

director.style: Empire: the Iman Gadzhi shorts look. Dark, expensive, confident. One glowing caps phrase at a time, typed on; the verdict phrase red and bigger. Talk for 15-22 s, then the music drop takes over.
director.captions: captions.reds: 2-4 verdict words per reel (the payoff noun or the pain word: STRONG, FUTURE, DYING). Never filler.
director.objects: 1-2 popcard beats per reel: an object PNG (obj-*.png) on the noun as spoken, label = the spoken words (2-3 words), 1.2-1.8 s. Objects only, never people.
director.drop: drop.hold = the last take; hold = 0.1 + ladder + end card (~8.2 s). bpm 136 beats [2,2,2,1,1,1,1,1,1,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5]. Shots alternate cinematic stills (night city, highway, road, earth, mountains) and the speaker's own best moments.
director.end: endcard variant caps, 1.6-1.9 s, FOLLOW FOR MORE with FOLLOW in green, fade 0.8 s.
director.dont: No creator names, logos or org names on screen; no religion/politics; no foreign text.
